manualRounds.action: Opened X2 panel; selected TAKE WIN without a red/black gamble.

automaticSession.note: Observed stop after two rounds. Do not infer stop-after-one behavior or the implementation's comparison rule.

history.replayControl: Opened a new official SpinHistoryClient tab; replay content and controls were not independently verified.

controls.spin: Seven manual rounds reached observed final results; history independently lists all nine manual/automatic entries.
controls.stop: Clicked during manual round 1; one 0.10 DMO deduction was observed, with no second round in history. Exact stop timing was not measured.
controls.bet: Selected 0.20 DMO after 0.10 DMO; in-game bet and resulting debits confirmed.
controls.paytable: Opened/scrolled; plus control changed displayed table from 0.10 to 0.20 DMO; all shown payouts doubled. Table preview is distinct from changing the actual bet.
controls.auto: Menu, round-count selection, win and balance-decrease settings, start and automatic stop were exercised; two rounds completed.
controls.turbo: Quick Play prompt opened and ENABLE exercised; golden turbo indicator observed. No timing or FPS guarantee established.
controls.x2: Opened on the 0.40 DMO win; RED, BLACK and TAKE WIN were visible. Red/black choice and random gamble outcomes were not exercised.
controls.takeWin: 0.40 DMO added to the demo balance after collecting round 4.
controls.soundEffects: Visible toggle and mute icon tested. No audible output recorded or independently heard.
controls.backgroundMusic: Visible toggle changed; final setting off. No audio verification.
controls.fullscreen: Toggle visibly changed on and back off; top-level fullscreenElement was false, so actual fullscreen entry is not verified.
controls.history: Opened and verified nine bet/win entries. Replay opened a new tab only.
untested: all bet values and limit boundaries

animationEvidence.note: MP4 is a variable-time sequence of captured screenshots, padded by one black pixel for codec dimensions. It is not a native screen recording, FPS benchmark or game implementation. Original frames are retained.
